verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an A/B testing guide for comparing "two versions of your agent side-by-side to measure prompt, model, or configuration changes." This maps directly to the story. Supporting docs cover running the same scenarios across platforms and models, and automated per-change testing via GitHub Actions, which together enable regression catching between versions. Missing for 10: detail on how run-level diffs or regressions are surfaced (e.g. metric deltas, automatic regression flags), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the side-by-side comparison feature.
